show.name: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End
show.summary: The mage Frieren defeated the Demon King alongside the hero Himmel's party after a 10-year quest. Peace was restored to the kingdom. Because she is an elf, she is able to live over a thousand years. She promises Himmel and the others that she will be back to see them and then sets out on a journey by herself. Fifty years later, Frieren goes to visit Himmel and the others. She remained unchanged, but Himmel and the others have aged and only a little of their lives remain. Later, she witnesses Himmel's death. Frieren is pained by her desire to have spent more time getting to know people. With that regret in her heart, she then goes on a journey to do just that. On her journey, she meets many people and many events await her.

show.name: Sousou no Frieren: ●● no Mahou
show.summary: Frieren loves collecting peculiar spells, and her ever-growing arsenal of magic contains the perfect spells for many occasions. Whether it be by stealthily removing alcohol from Heiter's drinks or by remedying her own sleep issues, Frieren is sure to brighten her companions' days with her magic.

previousepisode.name: Magic that makes you say what you're thinking, Part 2

show.name: Frieden
show.summary: 1945. War is over. Switzerland, the neutral small country at the heart of Europe, was all but spared: Klara, her fiancé Johann and his brother Egon are looking bright-eyed into the future. While Klara tries to mend the wounds of the war by caring for young, displaced holocaust survivors, Johann, who works for her industrialist father, hopes to save and modernize his father-in-law's well-established, yet troubled textile company. Just home from military service, Egon takes his first steps in the Attorney General's office. His mission: to hunt down escaped Nazis. All three of them soon realize that the facade of peace is bought with the blood of the victims of war. Johann's professional ambitions bring him closer to those who committed unspeakable war crimes. Klara risks her marriage while growing ever closer to Herschel, one of the survivors, who are all met with distrust by the locals. And Egon finds himself caught in a system that willingly turns a blind eye towards Nazi criminals for the sake of profit.

show.name: Friheden
show.summary: Some 20 years ago, Nina and Erik were brilliant con-artists. Now, they live a peaceful family life in the suburbs of Copenhagen, although their marriage is somewhat lackluster, and they have trouble making ends meet. One day, their partner in crime from the old days, Jacqueline, reappears with a new idea for a scam with plenty of money to be made!

show.name: 2 frères
show.summary: 2 frères tells the story of 19-year-old Gabriel, a university student recently landed in Montreal, and Zacharie, 15, whose behavior is rebellious and confusing. Gradually, Gabriel discovers that his brother has become a taxer at school and gradually gets involved in less legal and more violent activities.

show.name: Prière d'enquêter
show.summary: Captain Elli Talleb leads her investigations with an criminology expert who has taken holy orders, Brother Clément Desmoulin.

show.name: Les Frères Apocalypse
show.summary: In a mutation-riddled post-apocalypse, two dysfunctional survivalist brothers are hired to become protectors of their rural hometown. But their best hope lies in finding a secret military super-bunker that could ensure the town's survival for the next 200 years.

show.name: Oscar Freire 279
show.summary: Dora is a young new architect who moves from Curitiba and goes to work selling in São Paulo, until she meets Beto and is introduced to the world of prostitution.

show.name: Auf Herz und Nieren
show.summary: The newly qualified specialist Nina Hansen should actually take over her uncle's practice in two years. But suddenly the aging general practitioner Harry Hansen has health problems. When the cosmetic surgeon David Heller saves his life, his uncle makes a decision: In order to be able to cut back on his professional life, both are more committed at the same time: his niece and the cosmetic surgeon, who is still assuming that he will only temporarily step in as a substitute doctor. Because for him, treating patients with statutory health insurance is a chore and completely unprofitable. Uncle Harry, however, relies on his good heart and hopes that his niece will also find good things about the young doctor so that they can continue his practice together. - For the time being, however, two worlds collide that couldn't be more different.
